**Fixes you can trust, and a Docker install that starts first time**

- **No more guessing.** Docubil used to write a placeholder title, set every document's language to English, and mark untagged PDFs as tagged. Now it fixes something only when the document itself shows what the fix should be, and otherwise tells you what's left for you to do.
- **Fixes actually reach your PDF.** Language, tagging-flag, title-display and form-tooltip fixes were reported but never saved into the download. They are now.
- **More accurate checks:** form fields inside groups are found (all 236 on the IRS 1040, not 1), and alt text in tagged documents is read rather than assumed missing.
- **Docker works out of the box:** a fresh `docker-compose.release.yml` install starts, and reports open and are cleaned up on schedule. Behind a reverse proxy, set `TRUST_PROXY=1` so each user gets their own rate limit.

### Before you upgrade

Running from source now needs **Node.js 24**. Docker users don't need to do anything.

What's next: Docubil is moving all processing into your browser, so documents never leave your device. See the [plan](https://github.com/jshields-ca/Docubil/blob/main/PLAN.md).
